title: Network, storage and keys
sub: The seventh film of Locks before the data, the first series of Data protection and privacy: Rome's water in the year 97, drawn only at a tank, through a stamped nozzle, once its channels' holes were closed; a platform's files, reached nine ways around its catalog; private doors in and a short list out; one identity at the files, the catalog's own; each catalog bound to its own workspace; the one door you switch on and watch; and a key of the university's own.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's look, Night glass: a dark hall of frosted panes, frosted where what's behind may not be read and clear where it may, with cards of near-clear frost and bright rims. Cyan is an identity, green allowed, coral denied or closed, amber power switched on; a secret, such as an account key, is always a sealed card with a gold chip, never written out. Rome in the year 97 is painted in the same night light, with its place and year on a tag; where the voice names Azure Databricks, Unity Catalog, Azure Storage or Key Vault, the tool's official logo stands beside its name.
